message Step {
	required binary episode_id (STRING);
	required int32 step_idx (INT(32,true));
	optional int32 parent_idx (INT(32,true));
	required int32 attempt (INT(32,true));
	required binary kind (ENUM);
	optional binary role (STRING);
	optional binary content_ref (STRING);
	optional binary content_inline (STRING);
	required boolean truncated;
	optional binary tool_name (STRING);
	optional binary tool_version (STRING);
	optional binary args_hash (STRING);
	optional binary model (STRING);
	optional binary provider (STRING);
	optional group params {
		optional double temperature;
		optional double top_p;
		optional int32 max_tokens (INT(32,true));
		optional int64 seed (INT(64,true));
		required group stop (LIST) {
			repeated group list {
				required binary element (STRING);
			}
		}
	}
	optional group token_counts {
		optional int64 input (INT(64,true));
		optional int64 output (INT(64,true));
		optional int64 cached (INT(64,true));
		optional int64 reasoning (INT(64,true));
	}
	required group token_spans (LIST) {
		repeated group list {
			required group element {
				required int64 start (INT(64,true));
				required int64 end (INT(64,true));
				required binary trainable (ENUM);
			}
		}
	}
	required binary trainable (ENUM);
	optional binary logprobs_ref (STRING);
	optional binary finish_reason (STRING);
	required int64 started_at (TIMESTAMP(isAdjustedToUTC=true,unit=MICROS));
	optional int32 latency_ms (INT(32,true));
	optional group error {
		required binary type (STRING);
		required binary message (STRING);
	}
	optional group raw (MAP) {
		repeated group key_value {
			required binary key (STRING);
			required binary value (STRING);
		}
	}
}
